LanguageData.VFEI_BurrowSiege.label: burrow siege
LanguageData.VFEI_BurrowSiege.letterText:
A swarm of rare royal insects is tunneling towards you! They will break through in a few seconds and create burrows, that will allow more and more insects to reach the surface. These burrows can only be destroyed using explosives, but they will also collapse after some time.

The burrows will send insectoids in decreasing intervals until they become too unstable.

The insects belong to the royal geneline and are significantly harder to kill than their standard counterparts.
LanguageData.VFEI_HordeWaveRaid.label: horde wave raid
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestedChunkCrash.label: infested chunk crash
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestedChunkCrash.letterText:
A number of small chunks of an ancient ship has crashed nearby. 

They seem to be infested with an organic mass. Bizarre insect chittering can be heard within the hull. 

Destroy them as soon as possible.
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestedModuleCrash.label: infested module crash
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestedModuleCrash.letterText:
A mysterious segment of a long destroyed spaceship has crashed nearby.

It seems to be completely covered in biomass and lumps of insectoid jelly. It is fairly certain that this old wreckage may contain ancient dangers.

Destroy it as soon as possible.
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestedPartCrash.label: infested part crash
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestedPartCrash.letterText:
A large piece of an ancient ship has crashed nearby.

It seems to be infested with an organic mass. Bizarre insect chittering can be heard within the hull.

Destroy it as soon as possible.
LanguageData.VFEI_LargeInfestation.label: large infestation
LanguageData.VFEI_LargeInfestation.letterText:
A large swarm of giant insects is tunneling towards you! They will break through in a few seconds and plant hives, as well as other insectoid-built formations.

The hives will spawn more insects and more hives.

If you don't want the insects to infest the whole area, destroy the hives. But beware - the bugs will defend their home.
LanguageData.VFEI_RoamingInsectoids.label: roaming insectoids
LanguageData.VFEI_RoamingInsectoids.letterText: {0} has been ambushed by insectoids from {2}!
